subject: English
question_text: ........ Southamptom (ii) ......... Titanic The ship struck the It first (iii) ......... ice-berg voyage (iv) ........ began to
stimulus: In 1912, an American Shipping Company launched a new ship called "Titanic." It was the largest and most luxurious ocean liner of the time. It weighted 46000 tones and could carry about 2200 passengers. Experts said that nothing could make it sink. On April 10, 1912 the ship sailed on its first voyage across the Atlantic. It sailed from Southampton in England to New York in the United States with 2224 passengers of men, women and children. On April 15, just before mid-night the ship suddenly struck the huge ice-berg tore the ship and made a great hole at the bottom of it. Then the so called unsinkable Titanic began to sink. There was a great alarm on board. Warning bells rang out. Everyone rushed to the life boat but there was not enough room for all of them. There was room for only 1178 passengers. The life boats took mostly the women and the children. It was a terrible scene. Still it is a legend in the history of tragedy in the world.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Suggestions Unseen Comprehension-12
